$comment: Controlled vocabulary for catalog entries. The validator rejects source files using terms not listed here, which keeps search predictable as the catalog grows. Adding a term is a normal PR - add it here with a definition, then use it.

capabilities.components: Ready-to-use UI components you install or copy into a codebase.
capabilities.primitives: Unstyled or low-level building blocks (behaviour and accessibility, no opinion on looks).
capabilities.theming: Tokens, themes, dark mode, or systematic customization of appearance.
capabilities.design-tokens: Named values for color, type, spacing, radius, elevation and friends.
capabilities.accessibility: Keyboard, focus, ARIA and assistive-technology behaviour.
capabilities.motion: Animation, transitions, gesture and easing guidance or implementation.
capabilities.layout: Page and screen composition, grids, responsive structure.
capabilities.typography: Typeface selection, scale, and text treatment.
capabilities.color: Palette construction, contrast, and color systems.
capabilities.iconography: Icon sets and icon usage guidance.
capabilities.design-language: A documented, reusable description of how a product should look and feel.
capabilities.brand: Identity, logo, voice, and brand-consistency guidance.
capabilities.inspiration: Curated examples and references to look at before building.
capabilities.asset-sourcing: Where to get fonts, photos, illustrations, mockups, and other raw material.
capabilities.component-workshop: Developing, documenting, and testing components in isolation.
capabilities.documentation: Generating or hosting docs for a UI system.
capabilities.image-generation: Producing raster imagery from models or programmatic pipelines.
capabilities.agent-guidance: Instructions written to be read by a coding agent rather than a human.
capabilities.prototyping: Fast, throwaway exploration of several directions before committing.
capabilities.code-review: Evaluating existing UI code or output against a standard.

style_tags.editorial: Magazine-like: strong typographic hierarchy, asymmetry, long-form rhythm.
style_tags.brutalist: Raw, high-contrast, deliberately unpolished, visible structure.
style_tags.neo-brutalist: Hard shadows, thick borders, saturated flat color, playful.
style_tags.glassmorphism: Translucent layers, blur, depth through transparency.
style_tags.neumorphism: Soft extruded surfaces, low contrast, subtle dual shadows.
style_tags.corporate: Enterprise-safe, dense, conservative, high information density.
style_tags.dark-first: Designed dark, light mode secondary or absent.
style_tags.luxury: Restrained palette, wide letter-spacing, large imagery, slow motion.
style_tags.gradient-heavy: Gradients as a primary expressive device.
style_tags.neutral: Intentionally unopinionated - a base to theme, not a look.
